topic: What would happen if humans had no sleep?

scenario.title: What If Humans Never Slept?
scenario.clickbait_title: You'd NEVER Survive 48 Hours Without Sleep. Here's Why.
scenario.thumbnail_concept: Close-up of a person's wide, bloodshot eye, darting nervously, reflected in a distorted, wavy mirror. Subtle, unsettling shadow figures in the reflection's periphery. Dark, high-contrast lighting.
scenario.seo_description: What happens if humans never slept? Dive into the horrifying scientific reality of extreme sleep deprivation. Your brain and body would undergo irreversible changes, leading to a fate worse than death.

scenes.narration: Your reflection stares back, unfamiliar. Shadows flicker. Paranoia takes hold. You haven't slept in 48 hours. Reality warps.
scenes.visual_prompt: A close-up, vertical shot of a person's wide, bloodshot eye darting nervously, reflected in a distorted, wavy mirror, with subtle, unsettling shadow figures moving in the periphery of the reflection. Cinematic lighting, photorealistic, 8K detail. Camera slowly pushes in on the eye, creating a sense of unease. Vertical composition.
scenes.twist_element: The warping reality and the immediate, terrifying onset of paranoia, leaving the viewer wondering what happens next.

scenes.narration: But it worsens. Your immune system crashes. Organs begin failing. Every touch feels like burning. Your body rejects itself. How long can you last?
scenes.visual_prompt: A vertical shot of a human body rendered translucent or in X-ray style, showing internal organs visibly struggling, dimming, or emitting faint, sickly green pulses. The skin appears cracked and inflamed. Camera slowly pans down the body, revealing more internal distress. Dynamic, 8K detail, photorealistic, cinematic lighting.
scenes.twist_element: The visceral horror of the body physically rejecting itself, escalating from mental breakdown to full systemic collapse, with the implied question of impending death.

scenes.narration: Roli has seen this. Your brain won't just fail. It shrinks. Permanently. Memories vanish. You become a hollow shell, forever awake.
scenes.visual_prompt: Roli, the photorealistic anthropomorphic rabbit scientist, in a worn brass-and-leather steampunk spacesuit with goggles on his forehead, amber eyes, holding his glowing blue pocket-watch. He stands in a dimly lit, futuristic lab. Behind him, a holographic display shows a human brain visibly shrinking and losing neural connections. Roli looks directly at the camera, a somber, knowing expression. Vertical composition, cinematic lighting, 8K detail.
scenes.twist_element: The irreversible, permanent brain damage and total memory loss, revealing a fate worse than death itself, delivered by Roli's eerie, experienced perspective.

scenes.narration: And there's no going back. The damage is irreversible. Your conscious mind trapped, watching the world without understanding. Every single second, perpetually.
scenes.visual_prompt: A vertical shot of a person staring blankly into the distance in a busy, vibrant city street, their eyes vacant and unresponsive, with a faint, almost imperceptible static overlay. The crowd moves past them, oblivious. Camera slowly zooms out, emphasizing their isolation and the world continuing without their comprehension. Cinematic lighting, 8K, photorealistic. This shot should visually loop back into the opening scene's sense of distorted reality.
